inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped report uses GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(... IFNULL(...)) ORDER BY FIELD(...) SEPARATOR ...) to serialize related labels in a domain-specific order while retaining fallback text for NULL values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent catalog-label report. Items left join fixed tag rows, duplicate tag payloads are removed, NULL tag values use an explicit fallback, FIELD orders known tag classes before unknown classes, and an item without tags remains NULL. The source view, schema, labels, values, and game context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Item 10 has duplicate core rows and a NULL bonus value; item 20 has a rare and unknown tag; item 30 has no tag rows and must retain a NULL aggregate. FIELD puts core before bonus before rare before legacy, with unknown labels after known labels.
determinism_notes: Item IDs, tag IDs, fixed FIELD priority, secondary tag-name ordering, duplicate rows, NULL values, and final item ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE catalog_tags (tag_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_id INT NOT NULL, tag_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, tag_value VARCHAR(32) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.tag_name, '=', IFNULL(t.tag_value, 'unset')) ORDER BY FIELD(t.tag_name, 'core', 'bonus', 'rare', 'legacy') ASC, t.tag_name ASC SEPARATOR '|') AS tag_summary FROM catalog_items AS i LEFT JOIN catalog_tags AS t ON t.item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY i.item_id, i.item_name ORDER BY i.item_id

checks.sql: SELECT item_id, item_name FROM catalog_items ORDER BY item_id
